analysis.note: Jabbit analysis. Cerebrolysin is a licensed injectable pig-brain peptide mixture in parts of Europe and Asia, not approved in the US. The largest stroke trial was neutral, the Cochrane review found no effect on death and a possible rise in non-fatal serious adverse events, and positive results come mostly from smaller, often manufacturer-linked trials. There is no trial of cognitive enhancement in healthy people.
